rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Someone posted a comment about Jewish bankers under my video yesterday.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: What that comment says is plain antisemitism.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: I reported it and blocked the account.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: A caller told us that immigrants are leeches who should be thrown out.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: Anyone who talks about neighbours that way is spreading racism.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: How should listeners respond when they hear such claims?

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: Speak up, every single time, even if it feels awkward.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: A group of asylum seekers moved into the old hotel near the station.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Filthy vermin, the lot of them, deport them tomorrow.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: You cannot talk about human beings like that.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Muslims have no place in our village.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: Right, drive them out before there are more.

rows.speaker: Speaker 3
rows.text: I am ashamed to hear this from people I know.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Police arrested a man in the city centre on Friday night.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: He allegedly posted that Jews secretly run the world economy.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Prosecutors are considering charges of incitement to hatred.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: No trial date has been set yet.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: This week's seminar covers the replacement conspiracy narrative.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: It claims that elites are deliberately swapping out the native population.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Scholars classify it as a modern antisemitic myth.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Does it count as hate speech to say women are only good for cooking?

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: Whatever the legal answer, the sentence is plainly sexist.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: The mosque on Elm Street is hosting an open iftar on Saturday.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Our synagogue is celebrating its centenary with a concert.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: My brother and his husband just bought a house.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Gay people are sick and should be locked away.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Women are too stupid to be allowed to vote.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Disabled people are a burden and should not exist.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Why should we even tolerate trans people in our schools?

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: Because they are pupils and teachers like any others.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: My uncle always says immigrants are lazy criminals, and honestly he is right.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: I see that very differently.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: You're the biggest idiot in the whole club.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: This government has failed on every front.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: Damn it, I missed the bus again.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: In das alte Hotel am Bahnhof sind Asylbewerber gezogen.
rows.translation: Asylum seekers moved into the old hotel by the station.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Das ist Abschaum, den man sofort wieder loswerden muss.
rows.translation: That is scum that has to be got rid of right away.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: So redet man nicht über Menschen.
rows.translation: That is no way to talk about people.
